title: Design System: Oracle SQL Optimization Guidebook

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Home title-block entrance; transform-only, resting state visible. Plays once per document, gated on data-title-entrance, so a client navigation cannot restart a 740ms stagger underneath the 810ms zone swap.

motion.name: route-zones-jump
motion.value: per zone, old: opacity 1 → 0, 190ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1) at 0/45/90/135/180ms for rh/rail/body/pager-prev/pager-next, z-index 2; new: opacity 0 → 1, 190ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) at 530/575/440/485/620ms in reverse order, z-index 1; rail and pager translate X by ±60px, body and rh do not move; groups animation none
motion.purpose: Sanctioned opacity #1, the jump variant: a section jump scatters the page and reassembles it in reverse. data-nav='jump' on <html> is written on astro:before-preparation and re-written on astro:after-swap, because the router reapplies the incoming document's <html> attributes and deletes it in between. Every arriving half animates opacity too, so it is an opaque snapshot UNDERNEATH from frame one and the departing piece is uncovered rather than faded toward nothing — the composite is a draw over an opaque fill and can never be darker than the page. That is the fix for a dip: the UA adds -ua-mix-blend-mode-plus-lighter to ::view-transition-old/new(root) and Astro's astroFadeIn/astroFadeOut bake plus-lighter into their own keyframes, addition is only correct while the two opacities sum to 1, and a stagger breaks that for as long as any zone is in flight, so on this #0c0c0e paper the frames rendered under-exposed and the page dimmed in the middle. The root pseudo is pinned to mix-blend-mode: normal over a zero-duration animation for the same reason. The animation shorthand, not longhands, because the UA's blend is a second animation on the same pseudo-element and a longhand cannot reach it. The zone selectors are BARE: an ancestor-qualified html[data-nav='jump'] ::view-transition-old(body) does not match the view-transition pseudo tree at all, so it parses, reaches the CSSOM, and never applies. 810ms total.

motion.name: route-zones-pager
motion.value: same exit; on arrival title 440ms and body 485ms both zone-in-up, translateY(-36px) → 0; pager-next 440ms X +60px, pager-prev 485ms X -60px, rail 530ms X -60px, rh 575ms dissolve; title view-transition-name is 'title' only under data-nav='pager'
motion.purpose: Sanctioned opacity #1, the pager variant: a next/previous cell is a deliberate step along a linear book, so the new page is anchored on its own title and the reading column cascades down out of it, while the rail and pager cells still come in from their own edges. Selected by rel="prev"/"next" rather than by destination. The title is a zone for this variant only: a pager hop is between two pages of the same shape, so pairing the headings means something, whereas a section jump can put a 96px text-display home title against a 40px text-title section heading, which is a scale morph and a ghost rather than a pairing.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.value: grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr, 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) with a 40ms delay in both directions; caret rotate 0° → 45° on the same delay
motion.purpose: Native details/summary Research Notes; opens and closes symmetrically. The row, the glyph and the padding release all share one 40ms delay from --disclosure-delay, because 280ms of travel with no latency reads as a removal rather than a fold. The two header dropdowns additionally dismiss on an outside press, on focus leaving, and on Escape — on the shared animated path, never by setting open=false, which would skip the collapse and the padding release the summary-click close gets.

motion.name: rail-collapse
motion.value: grid-template-columns 280px ↔ 0px and gap 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); the control's translate into the gutter, 280ms, and its arrow rotate 180deg
motion.purpose: Collapsing the TOC rail. Layout and transform only. One control, not two: it slides from the rail's right edge into the gutter and its arrow turns to face the way the rail went, so the press and its consequence are one object moving. The visible chip is 28px inside a 44px hit area, the header's own icon-button treatment.

motion.name: dropdown-dismiss
motion.value: no animation of its own; reuses the disclosure close
motion.purpose: Outside press, focus leaving, or Escape on the two header dropdowns. State, not motion: the dismissal is what makes a panel snappy and the delay is what keeps it smooth. The evidence key and the mobile outline ship the same markup and do not dismiss.

motion.name: prose-rhythm
motion.purpose: The gap between blocks of the article, as a LENGTH rather than an em. An em resolves against the element's own font-size, so a paragraph got 22.5px and a code frame 18px from the same declaration, and the heaviest block on the page was separated by less space than a paragraph got. One length on :root, inherited identically everywhere, and still moving with --type-scale because it is built on --type-body. About one line box: a paragraph break is a blank line.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single solid accent control — Begin at Preface.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Header triggers — Sections, Reading, Theme. No box at rest: the label identifies the control, so 1.4.11 has nothing to require, and the box returns on hover, open and focus-visible at --control-edge. A 1px transparent border keeps the box model reserved so the edge appearing moves nothing.

narrative.overview: A scholarly reading surface for junior developers learning evidence-graded Oracle SQL tuning. The world borrows the apparatus of a research preprint — title block, numbered contributions, running heads, zone-ramped evidence grades — and makes it navigable as a 37-page web book. Dark near-black paper is the default ground; light mode is a full palette swap. Structure comes from hairline rules, mono tabular metadata, and one solid accent for the primary path.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black paper with stepped neutral zone ramp (A1–D) for evidence grades
Source Serif 4 for reading/display; Inter for UI chrome; JetBrains Mono for grades and measured figures
One restrained ink accent for primary action and active wayfinding only
Hairline title-block framing and rules instead of cards
Sticky section TOC as margin apparatus
Force annotation: measured values render as mono tabular inline figures

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on at most one solid control per viewport and on the active wayfinding state.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Body prose never exceeds 68ch. Display never exceeds 6rem. Tracking never tighter than -0.04em.

rules.name: Flat by Contract
rules.body: No authored box-shadows exist in any theme, and Expressive Code frames are flat. Depth is tonal: paper → raised → sunken, separated by 1px hairlines and never by blur or offset shadows.

dos: Do keep the accent on one solid control and the active TOC state per viewport.
Do render grades, citations, and measured numbers in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do frame major regions with 1px hairlines and title-block rules, not cards.
Do hold body measure at 68ch and display at max 6rem.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette tokens.
Do ship dark as default with a complete light palette swap.
donts: Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't use side accent stripes >1px on list items, callouts, or TOC rows.
Don't put Unicode glyph icons where an authored SVG belongs.
Don't introduce a second solid accent button or a hero-metric card grid.
Don't add a box-shadow, a --shadow-* token, or a Tailwind shadow-* utility in any theme — depth is tonal.

Don't animate prose, a disclosure, or any other reading element in from opacity 0 — first paint is the resting state and in-page motion is transform-only. Exactly one opacity transition is sanctioned: the whole-page ClientRouter route fade. It is navigation feedback, never content entrance.
Don't size a title-block or reading-surface column track by its content — an `auto` track is how a 150px disclosure reflows a whole page.
Don't move only one cap of the reading column: the track and the measure bind independently and the measure is the one that shows.
Don't scale part of the type ramp — every absolute `--type-*` step multiplies by `--type-scale`, and the two `em`-relative steps must not.
Don't rewrite, reorder, or reword the frozen notebook content.
